headline.one_liner: Six data centres sit within 8 km of you, in ESB Networks' area. A typical Irish home pays about €45 more a month than two years ago.

on_your_grid.summary: Six data-centre facilities sit within 8 km, five running and one under construction. ESB Networks is the distribution operator for Ireland, your street included.

coming.summary: An Coimisiún Pleanála granted permission with conditions for the Grange Castle data storage expansion, 9.4 km south of you, in September 2026.
coming.gap: No aerial imagery is indexed for Ireland, so new roofs are not measured.

your_bill.summary: Ireland's average household electricity price rose 49.5% between the first half of 2024 and the first half of 2026. For a home using 350 kWh a month that is about €45 more per month, between €36 and €54 depending on how much you use.

protection.summary: No. A CRU connection policy for new data centres is in force: they must bring generation or storage to match the capacity they ask for. Its stated aim is grid constraints, security of supply and renewable targets, not household costs.
